isolation: Primary run used unique origin http://127.0.0.1:47114; independent self-review used new origin http://127.0.0.1:47214. Neither origin had prior case storage. Each Vite process was started fresh and stopped afterward.

actions.action: Primary run: created, renamed, and edited a resume, then returned to the list.
Confirmed the new resume was saved in the list but saw no success feedback.
Independent self-review repeated creation/editing, blurred the edited field by switching tabs, and returned to the list.

observations: Both new resumes appeared in the saved list with the current updated date.
Neither run exposed a Save action, saved-state indicator, toast, status message, or populated Notifications region after successful saving.
notes: Two fresh-origin repetitions confirm implicit saving works but the required success feedback is absent.
